scope: Complete 2021 first-printing multiplayer core, all four Oaths and true Visions plus Conspiracy, citizenship, Campaign, victory, first/later setup, and Chronicle; supplied official base errata applied. Clockwork Prince and New Foundations excluded.
method: Read the full candidate, complete supplied Law and Playbook extracts, full supplied errata, and both supplied reference renders. Inspected original Law p.2 and Playbook pp.6–7 renders for Supply, setup icons and map placements. Compared material claims, permissions, costs, timing, destinations, exceptions and end conditions, and checked for important omissions across each in-scope source section.

independence_statement: I am a new independent source auditor and was neither the repair author nor a blind reader. I used only the assigned candidate and authorized primary sources/errata, with their image renders. I did not consult questions, answer keys, reader answers, grades, earlier audits, manifests, other evaluation evidence, browsing, or parent conversation history. I made no summary repairs or edits. This is an independent source verdict; the exact candidate still requires its separate blind-reader testing.
limitations: This is source-fidelity review of the assigned multiplayer rules scope, not blind-reader usability testing or an exhaustive card database audit. Individual denizen/relic/edifice powers remain on their cards as stated in the candidate.
